story: Canva adds AI Controls: a switch to turn generative AI off

segments.label: THIS WEEK IN AI
segments.title: Canva adds an off switch for AI
segments.narration: Canva now gives you an off switch for generative AI.

segments.label: WHAT HAPPENED
segments.title: Two new AI settings in Canva
segments.narration: Canva added two settings. One turns generative AI features on or off. The other reduces AI-made content in the library.

segments.label: HOW IT WORKS
segments.title: Where to find the controls
segments.narration: Find the switch under Profile, Settings, Permissions. Library control: Your Account, AI Personalization.

segments.label: WHAT IT MEANS FOR YOU
segments.title: Useful tools stay, but there's a catch
segments.narration: Background Remover and Magic Grab still work. The library setting only reduces AI content. It's not a guarantee.

segments.label: OUR TAKE
segments.title: Set a team AI policy, then flip it
segments.narration: Our take: decide your AI policy, then flip it.
